name: US equity stress
summary: VIX above 20 at a three-month high as tech sell-off extends; S&P 500 3.5% off its high
state: The VIX rose about 10% on 2 Nov to around 21, a three-month high and above the 20 Watch line, as the sell-off in technology shares extended; the S&P 500 slipped 0.3% and the Nasdaq 0.7% while the Dow gained 0.6% (Investing.com). The S&P 500 is about 3.5% below its 52-week high. The 3 Nov midterms, 5 Nov Bank of England decision and 6 Nov payrolls fall this week.
for_you: Share prices are swinging more than usual. Pension and investment values may move more around this week's elections and central bank decisions.

sources.title: Investing.com — US stocks mixed at close; Dow up 0.60%

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
